annotations.text:
Sign in — three directions, same Waypoint tokens (neutral ground, teal fill #00838E, violet for people, Figtree, 12px fields, 14px buttons).
A · Map poster: the city full of your pins, a place just pulled from a TikTok. Most atmospheric; the map is decorative.
B · Teal band: the Home header band carried onto sign in, so the first screen and Home read as one. Quietest, most consistent.
C · Capture story: shows the product's mechanism (video → place → space) before you sign in. Most explanatory; bracketed names are placeholders.
Pick one and I'll build it into the app.
